ASEAN Nations Urged to Cooperate on AI Development

ASEAN nations are being urged to develop a unified strategy for artificial intelligence (AI) development to effectively navigate geopolitical pressures between the United States and China. While ASEAN has the potential to maintain a neutral stance, it requires greater internal coordination and action. Chinese AI companies are noted for spending less than their US counterparts while still narrowing the compute gap, suggesting a different approach to AI advancement. The region needs to consolidate its efforts to leverage AI's potential and manage its implications.
